inflator kit, it is recommended that you take the tire to an authorized retailer for inspection and repair as soon as possible, but at least
within 100 miles of driving. The tire sealant cannot seal and inflate sidewall damage, punctures larger than one-quarter inch, or a tire that
has unseated from the wheel. The sealant can only be used on one tire and for one time before its expiration date.
